description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Serco North America is seeking an Entry-Level ServiceNow Developer to support the development, configuration, and enhancement of ServiceNow applications across mission-critical systems. The role focuses on ITSM module implementation, ServiceNow component development, requirements analysis, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and collaboration with developers and stakeholders.
ServiceNow application developer configuring ITSM workflows, business rules, forms, and platform enhancements

Responsibilities:
• Assist in the development and configuration of applications on the ServiceNow platform using App Engine Studio
• Support implementation and customization of ITSM modules, including Incident, Change, and Request Management
• Develop and maintain ServiceNow components such as Forms and fields, Business rules, Client scripts, UI policies, Workflows and Flow Designer solutions
• Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, testing, and documentation
• Collaborate with senior developers, system administrators, and functional stakeholders
• Troubleshoot issues and support platform enhancements and continuous improvements
• Follow ServiceNow development best practices, security standards, and Serco development methodologies
• Maintain documentation for developed solutions and configurations

Requirements:
• U.S. Citizenship
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline
• Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and software development concepts
• Proficiency or coursework experience withJavaScript
• Basic knowledge ofHTML, CSS, and web-based application concepts
• Familiarity with relational databases and data modeling concepts
• Foundational understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) or IT operations principles
• Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
• The selected candidate must obtain the following ServiceNow certifications within six (6) months of hire: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• The selected candidate must obtain the following ServiceNow certifications within six (6) months of hire: ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

Preferred:
• Academic, internship, or project experience with enterprise systems or SaaS platforms
• Exposure to low-code or no-code development platforms
• Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies
• Experience consuming or building REST APIs
